title: Auxiliary Power Unit — Aft Mount — Install the Steel Link and the Replaceable Bushes
abstract: Cancelled bulletin. It gave the instructions for the first auxiliary power unit aft mount standard, the steel link with replaceable bushes, and is replaced in full by the spherical bearing bulletin.

sections.planning_reason: Elongation of the aft mount link bores was found on nineteen aircraft at the first heavy check, well inside the interval the design assumed. The original link is aluminium with an integral bore, so any wear is wear of a structural part and the only remedy is link replacement. Operators with high auxiliary power unit utilisation were replacing links at every heavy check, at a cost and downtime the programme could not defend.
sections.description: This bulletin gave the instructions to replace the aluminium aft mount link with a steel item of the same length and attachment geometry, to introduce a replaceable bush at both ends, to modify the firewall panel locally to clear the larger link boss and to ream the bracket bore to the new bush outside diameter. It is cancelled. The steel link it installs remains the required base standard, but the plain bushes it introduces are superseded by the spherical bearing arrangement and an operator embodying this bulletin today would immediately have to open the mount again.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Do not accomplish this bulletin. Operators that have already embodied it are at the required base standard and should proceed to the spherical bearing bulletin at the next opportunity. Operators that have not embodied it should accomplish the spherical bearing bulletin directly, which contains the steel link content of this bulletin as its first eight steps together with the bearing installation. The bracket reaming operation described here is common to both bulletins and only needs to be done once. Any kit already held against this bulletin remains usable: the steel link, the firewall panel and the retaining hardware are common items, and only the plain bushes are superseded. Contact the regional office before scrapping any held kit, because the common items can be exchanged against the replacement kit.
sections.effectivity_note: Cancelled for all aircraft. When active it applied to TITAN-88 aircraft in the MSN T00001 to T00121 range that were not yet at the spherical bearing standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN T00122 had the steel link from the production line.
sections.material_note: Kit K4910-1007-01 is no longer supplied. Kits already held may be exchanged for the replacement kit through the regional office; the steel link, firewall panel and retaining hardware are common and only the plain bushes are superseded.

type_data.compliance_time: Cancelled. No compliance time applies. Accomplish TTN-49-1013 instead.
